title: K2 v2 profile: product files, table contracts and the access documents
description: Frozen in phase 001 (platform/k2gen/INTERFACES.md); changed only through the orchestrator. Each definition is applied on its own, by k2gen.model.schema_errors: product to every contracts/<domain>/<product>/product.odps.yaml after the vendored ODPS v1.1.0 schema; contract to every <table>.odcs.yaml after the vendored ODCS v3.2.0 schema; grants to every grants.yaml; domains, roles and principals to the shared files. K2's custom properties sit in the standards' own customProperties lists, one {property, value} item each; an unknown property name fails. No definition has a field for a credential or a hash of one: those live in git-ignored files under ${K2_SECRETS} (ADR-055, the orchestrator's ruling on Q4).

slug.description: A domain, product or team name: lower case, words joined by single hyphens, at most 40 characters (k2gen.model.MAX_SLUG). No double or trailing hyphen, so its fence never holds `__` (A5), and <fence>__base, dbt_<fence>, pub_<fence> and <domain>_build stay within 63.

identifier.description: A column, role or function name: lower case, at most 63 characters (k2gen.model.MAX_IDENTIFIER), never a Trino 484 reserved word (k2gen.model.TRINO_RESERVED), since unquoted `current_user` is the session user. Emitters quote every name all the same (k2gen.model.quote_ident).

tableName.description: A table's name: an identifier with no `__`, the separator of <fence>__base, <fence>__<role> and the dbt model name <fence>__<table> (k2gen.model.TABLE_NAME), so `x__base` is refused.

template.description: A connector string the fetch renders per run: it may hold the run's date, {{ds}}, and no other macro, since Airflow renders whatever it is given and a variable or connection macro could read a secret (k2gen.model.TEMPLATE).

plain.description: A connector string no one renders: no brace at all.

semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, major.minor.patch, no pre-release part.

day.description: A UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted in YAML: unquoted, YAML reads a date, not a string.

adr.description: An ADR number, ADR-NNN; its file is docs/adr/ADR-NNN-*.md.

text.description: Free text for a person to read; never empty.

productId.description: A product's stable id, <domain>.<product>, stable across stores (ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.3).

contractId.description: A table contract's stable id, <domain>.<product>.<table>: what ports and relationships name.

principalId.description: A principal: p.<pseudonym> for a person, svc.<name> for a service or a partner, dbt_<fence> for a product's builder and pub_<fence> for its publisher (A8, A10).

envName.description: The name of an environment variable that holds a secret at run time. The secret itself is never in a document or a release.

host.description: A DNS host name, lower case, no scheme, no port.

cron.description: A five-field cron expression in UTC, as Airflow reads it.

fileFormat.description: The format of the bytes a file or API connector lands, which its parser reads.

parser.description: A registered parser: the module domains/<domain>/parsers/<name>.py of the product's own domain, exposing parse(data: bytes) -> list[dict] and one function per declared audit (A4).

domains.description: contracts/domains.yaml: the data mesh domains (ADR-033). Unchanged from k2.schema.json, which step S23 deletes.
Domain name to its owner, kind and description.

owner.description: The owning team; .github/CODEOWNERS names it for contracts/<domain>/.

kind.description: Whether the domain's products face a source or a consumer.

topics.description: The Kafka topics this domain's capture writes: only a product of this domain reads one, and only one product reads each (k2gen check connectors.topic-not-owned, connectors.topic-claimed-twice). Here, in the file the platform team owns, and not in a product's directory, which its author edits.

product.description: K2's profile of an ODPS v1.1.0 product file (product.odps.yaml), applied after the vendored ODPS schema: the optional fields K2 requires, the values it allows, and its custom properties. One product, one directory contracts/<domain>/<name>/, one lifecycle state (ADR-055).

name.description: The product's name, unique on the platform; its fence (hyphens as underscores) names its namespaces, builder, publisher and DAG (A5, A8). Reserved names: see k2gen.model.RESERVED_PRODUCT_NAMES.

version.description: The product's version; a dropped, retyped, renamed or re-keyed column of any table is a new major (S06).

status.description: The product's one lifecycle state (ADR-055 part 4). `paused` is K2's declared deviation from the standard's examples.

domain.description: A domain declared in contracts/domains.yaml; the directory the product lives in.

name.description: Equal to the domain's owner in contracts/domains.yaml (S05).

inputPorts.description: Every table of another product this product reads; its builder may read nothing else (ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.6).

name.description: The port's name: the input table's name.

version.description: The input contract's version this product was written against.

allOf.description: An input read empty when absent is optional: a required one with no audited snapshot stops the build first (wrapper exit 4).

outputPorts.description: Every table the product publishes, one port per table contract beside the product file.

name.description: The port's name: the table's name.

contractId.description: The table's contract id, <domain>.<product>.<table> of this product.

inputContracts.description: The tables that feed this table: product-level lineage, the catalog's lineage edges. Each is an input port's contract, or a sibling table of this product (bronze feeding silver), which is not an input.

id.description: An input port's contract id, or a sibling table's.

customProperties.description: K2's product properties; each at most once (S05).

allOf.description: Every state but active records why it changed (ADR-055 part 4).
A deprecated product names its sunset day and its successor.

productProperty.description: One K2 custom property of a product file.

value.description: The product whose DAG a build of this one degraded by one of the named warn rules starts, at most once an hour (W1-6): product, one the product's build depends on through its input ports, scheduled, declaring no refresh of its own; rules, the warn-severity rules of this product whose failure the target's run can cure (k2gen check refresh.*); pipeline.json refresh.

seeds.description: The CSV files under the product's seeds/ that dbt loads, each declared here and marked synthetic. Gate (i) of make check-docs passes a contracts/<domain>/<product>/seeds/<name>.csv only when its product file holds the line `- {path: seeds/<name>.csv, synthetic: true}` in that flow form, since the gate reads it with no YAML parser. Real reference data is not a seed: it is listed in NOTICE with its source and terms.

synthetic.description: Always true: invented rows, no source data.

timeoutMinutes.description: A run's timeout; set from the product's first measured runs.

terms.description: The source's licence terms, recorded before any grant to a principal outside the owning team (ADR-055 part 5).

redistribution.description: Whether the data may be passed on beyond the platform's readers.

attribution.description: The credit line the terms require, shown on the catalog page.

lifecycleChange.description: Why the product is in a state other than active.

since.description: The day the state took effect.

successor.description: The product that replaces a deprecated one.

sunset.description: The day a deprecated product may retire, at the earliest.

resume.description: For a paused product: where its connector starts again.

examples.description: Example queries for the catalog page.

sql.description: The query, against reader names only.

inputPortProperty.description: One K2 custom property of an input port.

value.description: A required input that was never audited stops the build (wrapper exit 4); an optional one is read as its whenAbsent says.
How far behind the input may be before this product is shown partial; null for no bound.

What the build reads for an optional input that is paused or was never audited. fail (the default): no snapshot fails the build at compile, and a paused input with one is read at it. empty: k2_input renders zero rows of the input's contracted columns, and the run records it with a null snapshot, so the product is partial. emptyIntoTable: as empty, also accepted when a model of this product is not incremental, which then rebuilds from zero rows and publishes empty; without it k2gen check refuses empty there (docs.empty-input-into-table).

outputPortProperty.description: One K2 custom property of an output port.

serves.description: A serving copy of the output outside the lake, such as the paused ClickHouse hot tier (ADR-057).

profile.description: The compose profile that runs it.

status.description: Whether the copy is served now.

connector.description: A source-aligned product's one connector (ADR-036), compiled into its pipeline.json. Secrets are named by environment variable only.

kafkaConnector.description: Reads the product's own topic at its own position; lands every record of the planned range byte for byte, control frames included, in lake.<fence>.landing, end offsets in the same commit (ADR-022); bronze is staged from the landing by offset, the filter applied there, each frame's envelope decoded by its writer schema id into bronze's envelope columns by field name, never its bytes (I-1, 2026-11-28). Built in phase 004.

brokers.description: Bootstrap servers, host:port, comma separated: each host a service of the stack's compose file on the load's network (k2gen check connectors.host-outside-stack); never a credential.

registry.description: The schema registry's URL, no userinfo: its host a service of the stack's compose file on the load's network (connectors.host-outside-stack).

contract.description: The contract that declares the envelope's schema; a contract of the set (connectors.envelope-unresolved).

filter.description: Bronze staging keeps only records whose envelope field holds one of the values and counts the rest per partition in the bronze commit's summary (k2.kafka-skipped); the landing holds every record whatever the filter, so staged plus skipped equals the landing range read (I-1).

payload.description: The format of the envelope's payload.

maxOffsetsPerPartition.description: The most records one run reads per partition.

publicApiConnector.description: Fetches a public JSON API in the fetch container; lands one object per changed response, named by its sha256. Built in phase 004.

url.description: The first page's URL, https only; may hold {{ds}}, no other macro.

allowHosts.description: The only hosts the fetch may connect to, redirects included (ADR-036 part 3), each matched exactly as written; the url's host among them (connectors.url-host-not-allowed).

params.description: Query parameters added to every request; a value may hold {{ds}}, no other macro.

pagination.description: How the next page is found. Only none compiles (k2gen check connectors.pagination-unsupported): fetch.py runs next-link (the Link header) and page (page=1, 2, ...), but no field here yet says where a next link sits in a body or names the page parameter and its start.

maxPages.description: The most pages one run fetches; required unless pagination is none.

minIntervalS.description: The least time between two requests, in seconds.

records.description: The response field that holds the records.

recordKey.description: The field that names each record, where records is a map.

volatileFields.description: Fields ignored when deciding whether a response changed.

authHeaderEnv.description: The environment variable holding an Authorization header value, if the API needs one.

httpsFileConnector.description: Fetches one file over https in the fetch container; lands it at s3://k2-landing/<domain>/<product>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<sha256>.<ext> (A5). Built in phase 002.

url.description: The file's URL, https only; may hold {{ds}}, the run's date, and no other macro.

allowHosts.description: The only hosts the fetch may connect to, redirects included (ADR-036 part 3), each matched exactly as written; the url's host among them (connectors.url-host-not-allowed).

calendar.description: The contract id of a calendars table: the days the source publishes.

maxBytes.description: A lower size cap than the fetch container's 64 MiB.

s3FileConnector.description: Reads one object from an S3-compatible store in the fetch container; lands it as https-file does. Built after the demo tag.

key.description: The object key; may hold {{ds}}, no other macro.

credentialsEnv.description: The environment variable prefix holding the access key pair.

calendar.description: The contract id of a calendars table: the days the source publishes.

sftpConnector.description: Reads one file over SFTP in the fetch container, trusting only the declared host key. Built after the demo tag.

path.description: The file's path; may hold {{ds}}, no other macro.

user.description: The login name; not a secret.

keyFileEnv.description: The environment variable naming the private key file.

hostKey.description: The server's public host key, as known_hosts spells it.

calendar.description: The contract id of a calendars table: the days the source publishes.

ftpConnector.description: Reads one file over FTP in the fetch container; plain FTP only for anonymous public data. Built after the demo tag.

path.description: The file's path; may hold {{ds}}, no other macro.

tls.description: required: FTP over TLS; none: plain FTP, anonymous only.

credentialsEnv.description: The environment variable prefix holding a login; absent for anonymous.

calendar.description: The contract id of a calendars table: the days the source publishes.

contract.description: K2's profile of an ODCS v3.2.0 table contract (<table>.odcs.yaml), applied after the vendored ODCS schema. Columns are inline and are the table's definition of record.

name.description: The table's name; the file is <name>.odcs.yaml.

purpose.description: What one row is, and what the table is for.

team.description: The owning team, as an object (ODCS v3.1.0 and later).

roles.description: The roles the table offers, each declared in contracts/access/roles.yaml (S07). No role offered means only the owner and the platform read it.

firstLevelApprovers.description: Who approves a grant of the role, if not the owning team.

slaProperties.description: Only targets a check enforces. latency: how old the newest value of element, <table>.<column>, may be; it becomes an alert.

customProperties.description: K2's table properties; each at most once (S05).

id.description: The table's name: fully qualified references use it (#/schema/<id>/properties/<column>).

physicalName.description: <product fence>.<table>: the namespace and table without a catalog. Its reader name follows the build kind (k2gen.model.reader_relation): a dbt or code output's is the view <domain fence>.<product fence>.<table>, a platform table's the table of that name, a connector table's lake.<product fence>.<table> (A5, A8). For build serving it is the serving engine's <database>.<table>.

physicalType.description: A table: an Iceberg table, which readers see through a generated view for a dbt or code output (ADR-061); for build serving, a table of the serving engine.

quality.description: Checks beyond the generated key and nullability tests, each run or refused, never dropped: custom with engine dbt is one dbt data test; custom with engine k2-connector is a bronze audit (a parser function); sql is a query reading the table as ${table}, and library the metric rowCount or duplicateValues (arguments.properties), each compared by ODCS's must* thresholds in a dbt test of a dbt-built table; text is words only. k2gen check reports any other form (docs.quality-unsupported).

engine.description: dbt: a dbt test; k2-connector: a connector audit, a parser function.

column.description: One column: an ODCS schema property.

physicalType.description: The Trino type exactly as Trino's typeof spells it, from the types an Iceberg table holds: boolean, integer, bigint, real, double, decimal(p,s) with p 1 to 38, varchar, varbinary, date, time(6), timestamp(6), timestamp(6) with time zone, uuid, and one level of array(t) or map(k, v) (k2gen.model.PHYSICAL_TYPE; a scale above its precision is refused by k2gen.model.physical_type_problem, in S05).
physicalType.pattern: ^(?:boolean|integer|bigint|real|double|decimal\((?:[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8]),(?:[0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8])\)|varchar|varbinary|date|time\(6\)|timestamp\(6\)|timestamp\(6\) with time zone|uuid|array\((?:boolean|integer|bigint|real|double|decimal\((?:[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8]),(?:[0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8])\)|varchar|varbinary|date|time\(6\)|timestamp\(6\)|timestamp\(6\) with time zone|uuid)\)|map\((?:boolean|integer|bigint|real|double|decimal\((?:[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8]),(?:[0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8])\)|varchar|varbinary|date|time\(6\)|timestamp\(6\)|timestamp\(6\) with time zone|uuid), (?:boolean|integer|bigint|real|double|decimal\((?:[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8]),(?:[0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8])\)|varchar|varbinary|date|time\(6\)|timestamp\(6\)|timestamp\(6\) with time zone|uuid)\))$

relationships.description: Keys of another product's table this column refers to.

columnProperty.description: One K2 custom property of a column; ODCS 3.2.0 has no unit or time-meaning field.

value.description: A unit or an ISO 4217 currency code.
What the timestamp means: when it happened, when it was published, when it is valid, when it was known.

relationshipProperty.description: One K2 custom property of a relationship.

value.description: When the target keeps history: join on its valid time or its knowledge time.
With asOf: the referring table's timestamp(6) with time zone column the join is as of (docs.relationship-as-of-column).

contractProperty.description: One K2 custom property of a table contract.

value.description: The layer the table is (ADR-055 part 2). A landing is not authored: its names follow from the connector (A5).
restore: copied and registered back; rebuild: rebuilt from its inputs (ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.9).
Snapshot expiry in days, never deletion of rows; at least the 7-day floor when another table reads it (S05).
Iceberg partition fields in order, as Trino spells them.
The write sort order, in order.

build.description: What writes the table, from a closed set (ADR-055 part 2).

oneOf.description: connector: the product's connector, into warehouse k2; dbt: a model in the product's directory, on Trino; platform: platform code, a table readers see directly (the run records); serving: no lake table, only the serving copy its output port's `serves` names (the paused hot tier), which every lake emitter, the rules and the relation helpers skip (k2gen.model.LAKE_BUILDS).
A registered code transform on Spark.

partitionField.description: A column, or a Trino Iceberg partition transform of one: year, month, day, hour, bucket(col, n), truncate(col, n).

sortField.description: A column, optionally ASC or DESC and NULLS FIRST or LAST.

policies.description: Per offered role, what its readers see (ADR-055 part 5). Each becomes a Trino rule on the view's exact name, never view SQL (ADR-061 condition 2). A role with no entry sees every row and column.

rolePolicy.description: The three named policies; never a free-form filter.

delay.description: Only rows whose column is older than minutes: column < current_timestamp - INTERVAL 'minutes' MINUTE.

column.description: A timestamp column of the table.

rowScope.description: Only rows whose column holds one of the values: column IN (values).

values.description: The values kept: integers, or strings of letters, digits, space and . _ : / - (k2gen.model.ROW_SCOPE_VALUE), each written through k2gen.model.sql_literal.

grants.description: contracts/<domain>/<product>/grants.yaml: who holds which role on this product. At most one role per principal per product (DECISIONS-FINAL O1a, S07); approved by the product's code owners.

role.description: A role declared in contracts/access/roles.yaml and offered by the product's tables.

roles.description: contracts/access/roles.yaml: the roles a table may offer (A10).

description.description: What a holder of the role sees.

requires.description: Policies every table offering the role must set for it (S07).

within.description: Roles whose holders see no less than this role's: an output may offer this role over an input offering one of them instead, held to that role's policy on the input (checks.access, access.inherit-role). Declared one pair at a time; no chain is followed.

principals.description: contracts/access/principals.yaml: everyone who may call Trino or the REST API, people under pseudonymous ids. No field holds a credential or a hash of one (the orchestrator's ruling on Q4): password and key hashes live in git-ignored files under ${K2_SECRETS}.
The principals, in any order; ids unique (S07).

kind.description: A person (p.*), a service (svc.*, dbt_*, pub_*), or a partner (svc.*): a service of another organisation, whose credential the platform never holds and which holds only the reader roles grants give it.

owner.description: The team answerable for the principal.
